family_decision.input: Finite rational algebraic/constructible coefficient family,including fixed n,D,r and prescribed symbols/support/homogeneity/rank charts
family_decision.pure_step: Compute full ordinary pure coefficient ideal and finitely many minimal primes
family_decision.generic_step: Pointwise all-multiplier decision on each generic field;original monomial witness extracted on failure
family_decision.all_pass: Each fixed multiplier tail is a polynomial coefficient identity in the prime,so vanishes on the entire component
family_decision.some_fail: Embed generic field inC,or specialize nonpolynomial witness to an exact number-field point
family_decision.exceptional_locus: Safe exceptions in a failing component need not be classified to decide existence of some failure
